settings.heading: Healthy Sleep Space Website and General Wellness Disclaimer
settings.body:
Effective date: September 1, 2026

This Disclaimer applies to the Healthy Sleep Space website, the Healthy Sleep Space worldwide general-wellness program, educational materials, product information, digital communications, participating-program content, and related services. Please read it carefully before using this website, joining the program, or purchasing a product.

General Wellness Purpose

Healthy Sleep Space is a general-wellness program. Products offered within the program are intended solely for general wellness use. The program does not provide medical services, medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, or disease-related guidance. Product-specific intended uses are stated on the applicable product pages and in the directions supplied with each product.

Healthy Sleep Space and products offered through the program are not intended to:

  • Diagnose a disease or medical condition
  • Cure, mitigate, treat, or prevent a disease
  • Screen for or monitor a medical condition
  • Provide medical or clinical measurements
  • Guide treatment or medication decisions
  • Replace an FDA-authorized medical device
  • Replace professional medical care

Do not use Healthy Sleep Space or any product offered through the program for a disease, symptom, diagnosis, or medical condition.

No Medical Advice

Information provided through this website is for general educational and wellness purposes only. It does not constitute and should not be interpreted as:

  • Medical advice
  • A medical diagnosis
  • A treatment recommendation
  • A prescription
  • Professional healthcare services
  • A substitute for consultation with a qualified healthcare professional

Nothing on this website establishes a physician-patient, healthcare-provider-patient, or other professional healthcare relationship between Healthy Sleep Space and any website visitor or customer.

Always seek the advice of a qualified healthcare professional regarding symptoms, medical conditions, medications, treatment choices, or other healthcare questions.

Do not disregard professional medical advice or delay seeking medical care because of information found on this website.

Medical Emergencies

Healthy Sleep Space does not provide emergency medical services.

If you believe you are experiencing a medical emergency in the United States, call 911 or seek immediate emergency assistance. Customers outside the United States should contact the appropriate emergency service in their location.

Do not use this website, its contact forms, email, chat, or customer-support telephone number for emergency medical assistance.

Product Information

We seek to provide clear and accurate information about each product's:

  • Intended general-wellness purpose
  • Features and specifications
  • Directions for use
  • Recommended setting
  • Safety information and limitations
  • Care and storage
  • Package contents
  • Warranty and customer policies

Product descriptions may be updated as products, instructions, testing, or company policies change. Always review the information accompanying your specific product.

If website information differs from the instructions supplied with the product, discontinue use and contact Healthy Sleep Space Customer Support for clarification.

Technology and Physical Measurements

References to photons, low-intensity photon emissions, wavelength, emission spectroscopy, radiometric characterization, surface temperature, or other physical measurements describe product characteristics under specified measurement conditions.

Such information does not establish or imply that a product:

  • Has been clinically proven to provide a medical benefit
  • Diagnoses or treats a disease
  • Produces a particular change in the human body
  • Provides clinical or medical-grade measurements
  • Is equivalent to an FDA-authorized medical device

Physical measurements should not be interpreted as evidence of medical effectiveness.

FDA Status and Government Endorsement

The FDA's general-wellness policy describes an enforcement approach for products that are intended solely for general wellness use and present low risk. Inclusion within or consistency with a general-wellness policy does not constitute FDA approval, clearance, authorization, certification, or endorsement.

Unless expressly stated on a specific product page and supported by an identified FDA authorization, nothing on this website should be interpreted as a representation that FDA or another government agency has reviewed, cleared, approved, certified, or endorsed a product offered through Healthy Sleep Space.

Healthy Sleep Space does not claim that products offered through the program are "medical grade" or "clinical grade."

Individual Experiences

People may experience wellness products and routines differently. No particular experience is promised or guaranteed.

Any customer comment, review, or personal statement that may appear on this website represents the individual's own experience. It should not be interpreted as:

  • A medical claim
  • Proof of product effectiveness
  • A guarantee of similar results
  • A substitute for objective product information
  • Medical advice from Healthy Sleep Space

Healthy Sleep Space does not rely on customer anecdotes to establish objective product claims.

No Guarantee of Healthy Sleep Space Results

Healthy Sleep Space is a program name, not a representation that improved sleep, increased energy, or any other specific outcome will occur. Healthy routines, schedules, environments, personal preferences, and individual experiences vary. Healthy Sleep Space does not guarantee a particular feeling, sleep experience, wellness outcome, or level of satisfaction.

Statements describing the program or a product's intended wellness purpose do not constitute a promise of a specific result.

Proper Product Use

Use each product offered through Healthy Sleep Space only:

  • For its stated general-wellness purpose and program role
  • In the recommended setting
  • In accordance with the supplied directions
  • Within any stated limitations
  • After reviewing applicable safety information

Do not modify, damage, misuse, or operate a product in a manner inconsistent with its instructions.

Inspect products before use. If a product is damaged, incomplete, or does not operate as described, discontinue use and contact Customer Support.

Healthcare Questions

Healthy Sleep Space team members, program representatives, customer-support representatives, affiliates, contractors, distributors, and participating locations are not authorized to diagnose conditions, interpret symptoms, prescribe treatments, or advise use of a wellness product for a medical purpose.

Questions about medical conditions, medications, pregnancy, implanted devices, healthcare procedures, or the suitability of a wellness product in light of an individual's medical history should be directed to a qualified healthcare professional.

Do not submit medical records, diagnostic reports, photographs of medical conditions, or other sensitive health information through the website's general contact forms.

Educational Content

The Healthy Sleep Space Wellness Library provides general educational information about nighttime routines, sleep habits, relaxation, wellness environments, healthy daytime choices, and product technology.

Educational content is not individualized and may not be appropriate for every person, culture, location, or circumstance. It should not be used to make decisions about diagnosis, treatment, medication, or medical care.

External Links

This website may contain links to third-party websites for convenience or general reference. Healthy Sleep Space does not control third-party content and is not responsible for its accuracy, availability, privacy practices, or terms.

A link does not necessarily constitute sponsorship, affiliation, approval, or endorsement. Information on an external website should not be interpreted as a claim made by Healthy Sleep Space about a product offered through the program.

Third-party medical information should be discussed with a qualified healthcare professional.

Worldwide Availability and Local Requirements

Healthy Sleep Space may be introduced in different countries through authorized channels or participating locations. Product availability, program features, language, instructions, consumer policies, and legal requirements may differ by location.

Global program language does not override local product labeling, instructions, safety information, consumer rights, or applicable law. Review the information provided for your country and specific product before purchase or use.

We seek to maintain accurate and current website information, but do not guarantee uninterrupted availability or that every page is error-free. Contact Customer Support if information appears incomplete, inconsistent, or inaccurate.

Separate Policies

Purchases and use of this website are also governed by the applicable:

  • Terms and Conditions
  • Privacy Policy
  • Cookie Policy
  • Shipping Policy
  • Return and Refund Policy
  • Product Warranty
  • Affiliate Disclosure
  • Product-specific directions and safety information

If there is a conflict between this Disclaimer and product-specific safety instructions, contact Healthy Sleep Space Customer Support before using the product.

Contact Us

Questions about this Disclaimer, Healthy Sleep Space, or the stated general-wellness purpose of a product may be directed to:

Healthy Sleep Space
111 McCoy Street, Milford, DE 19963, USA
Email: info@teslabiohealing.com
Telephone: 1-302-265-2213

Please do not send private medical or other sensitive health information through general contact channels.

Final General Wellness Notice: Products offered through Healthy Sleep Space are intended solely for general wellness use. They are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, mitigate, or prevent any disease or medical condition. Website information is provided for general educational and wellness purposes only and is not medical advice. Consult a qualified healthcare professional regarding medical concerns or before making decisions about your healthcare.
